params.body:
Two things Frederik asked for through Ilse on 23 September 2026, after entering two vehicles himself. He asks as the owner of the platform, so both are platform defaults rather than one garage's preference.

## 1. White is the default background

> Zou er standaard kunnen gekozen worden voor de witte achtergrond ipv de zwarte bij het dupliceren naar Stocklist aub?

The "Naar Stocklist kopiëren?" dialog preselects the sample the vehicle holds, and `background_type` defaulted to 0, which means dark. So every new vehicle opened on black and the dealer switched to white on each one.

The migration changes that default to light. **Only the default.** The column has never known NULL, not one row in 3.553, so a deliberate choice for dark is indistinguishable from a vehicle that was never asked, and those vehicles' existing copies already stand on dark. Flipping the meaning of 0 would rewrite real choices; changing the default writes nothing at all.

The test pins the chain end to end: a new vehicle holds light, the job picks the light file, a vehicle holding dark keeps dark, and the gallery passes the vehicle's value to the dialog that preselects on it.

## 2. A portal can publish VAT vehicles only

> Zou het mogelijk zijn om als we een margewagen invoeren (dus in tabblad prijzen: BTW = Neen), bij de portals 'Flexlease' en 'Goforlease' uitgevinkt staan? Dit zijn 2 portals die enkel BTW wagens publiceren.

Those two portals have carried the condition for years in their name, `Flexlease (enkel BTW-voertuigen)` and `goforlease.com (enkel BTW-voertuigen)`, and nowhere else. No line of code reads a name.

Counted first: **57 dealers** have such a portal switched on, and of the vehicles standing on one, **381 are VAT vehicles and 71 are margin vehicles.** The feature is used, and those 71 are offered to a portal that will not take them.

So the condition becomes data, `portals.vat_only`, not two ids in the code: a third portal with the same condition belongs in the database. On a margin vehicle such a portal is unticked and **disabled with the reason beside it** rather than hidden, so the dealer learns why instead of missing a portal he saw yesterday. And the save drops it regardless of what the screen did, at all three sync points, so the API and the imports are covered as well.

The existing 71 links are not touched here. They fall away when their vehicle is next saved; cleaning them in one go is a data change on production and is yours to decide.

## A correction worth recording

My first count said nine vehicles, all of them margin. That was wrong: I counted on `dealer_portals`, while a vehicle hangs through `vehicle_portals` on **`portaalsites`** (the `DealerPortal` model), which then points at `portals`. The two table names sit one letter apart in meaning and an hour apart in consequences, so that warning is written into the class and the test rather than left in a chat.

Verified locally: 34 tests, 95 assertions across both new tests, the sheet tests and the rule-catalogue tests.

---

Replaces #782, which failed static analysis on one line: a nullsafe on the left of `??` is unnecessary, because `?->` already yields null. The rule now reads as what it means, no vehicle counts as not allowed, so an unknown vehicle loses the portal instead of keeping it. `phpstan analyse` is green on the whole project locally.
params.title: Two details Frederik asked for: white by default, and no VAT-only portal on a margin vehicle
